## Input / evidence

If the problem uses an Nmap XML file, attach a minimal sanitized XML sample that reproduces it when possible.

For investigation or evidence-collection problems, state which phase failed (discovery, planning, authorization, collection, verification, final decision, history/memory) and include the relevant sanitized NetRecon output.

Do not post credentials, private keys, tokens, or sensitive target data.

## Reproduction

## Additional context

Anything else that may help distinguish a NetRecon defect from missing Nmap evidence, target behavior, or environment configuration.
